what_went_wrong: The first integrity-test version assumed 18 total provenance atoms and three T oracle rows, but the frozen five-boundary set contains 21 atoms and five T rows including accepted controls. It also compared a content hash to a file hash whose serialization added a newline.
root_cause: Counts were copied from the three-cell primary population rather than the full primary-plus-control population; hash comparison ignored file serialization.
correction: Tests now assert 21 provenance atoms, five T oracle rows, and exact T reconstruction text equality. Eleven tests pass.
